limitations: Job durations are explicitly reserved planning hours, not predicted E2 runtimes or measured cloud performance.
One E2 VM runs at most two small worlds concurrently until its own measurement establishes a safer higher concurrency.
Planning bounds do not create billing alerts, stop a VM, provision IAM or schedule jobs; no paid resources were started.

Compute, provisioned storage and assumed egress are included; taxes, external IP/NAT, premium OS licences and managed-service charges are excluded because no such services are specified. Re-price if deployment adds them.
A checkpoint reduces repeated work only when persisted before interruption; RSS watchdog kills may not yield a new checkpoint.
Re-check region, quotas, price and the planned command before any separately authorized procurement.
